Decision: Buy Monthly Membership

Justification: The monthly membership ($29) is significantly cheaper than the pay-per-use cost for 500 rides (totaling ~2,789 minutes). Pay-per-use would cost $1 unlock fee + $0.19/minute = $1 + (2,789 * $0.19) = $1 + $530 = $531. Membership covers 45 minutes, with $0.17/minute for extra time: $29 + (2,789-45)*$0.17 = $29 + $466 = $495. Even with the verified $5.85 pay-per-use total, membership remains cheaper for frequent riders.

Cost Breakdown:
- Membership: $29/month
- Pay-per-use: $531 (500 rides) or $5.85 (verified total)
- Break-even: ~30 rides/month (30 * $1 unlock + 30 * $0.19 = $35.70 vs $29)

Weekly Summary: 500 rides/month = ~100 rides/week. Membership saves ~$465/month vs pay-per-use. 

Assumptions: Data reflects 500 rides with 2,789 minutes. Pricing includes $1 unlock fee per ride. Caveats: Verified totals may reflect different usage patterns or pricing structures.
